outcome_states.account_nonexistent_value_null: success response with exact context slot and value null; explicit nonexistence at requested point
outcome_states.account_present_valid: success response, exact context slot, complete base64 data, owner/lamports/space validated, TLV parser status recorded
outcome_states.cross_source_conflict: independent same-slot source returns a different existence/owner/lamports/space/raw-data tuple
outcome_states.cross_source_match: independent source matches normalized whole-account tuple at same context slot
outcome_states.not_compared: no independent source response exists; raw envelope-hash differences alone are not state conflicts
outcome_states.not_requested_access_gate_pending: this manifest state; no request, response, time, or usage value exists
outcome_states.out_of_coverage: provider JSON-RPC error -32020; unknown state, not nonexistence
outcome_states.owner_mismatch: non-null account is not owned by Token-2022; retain exact result but do not treat as mint bytes
outcome_states.partial_or_malformed: missing required fields, invalid base64, byte-length/space mismatch, context-slot mismatch, or incomplete raw capture
outcome_states.provider_error: other JSON-RPC or HTTP provider error, retained verbatim only after redaction policy; no retry
outcome_states.transport_failure: transport failed or timed out; outcome/charge may be unknown, no identity retry

proposed_caps_not_authorization.authorization: none; any acquisition requires separate access/budget review and approval
proposed_caps_not_authorization.historical_archive_surcharge_or_meter: unknown; cap is provisional and not account-meter evidence
proposed_caps_not_authorization.proposed_byte_cap_basis: 65,536-byte per-response ceiling from the prior frozen control plan, scaled to 150 unique pairs; it is not a measured response-size bound
